meta.title: AI Helpdesk: omnichannel service desk demo
meta.description: Interactive service desk demo for Colombia with sample data: one ticket inbox for email, web chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram and calls; automatic classification and assignment, AI reply drafts grounded in your knowledge base, SLAs, macros, CSAT/NPS and PQRS tracked in business days.

demoHelpdesk.pageSubtitle: Omnichannel service desk: one inbox for all your channels, automatic classification and assignment, AI reply drafts, SLAs and PQRS tracked in business days. Try it: simulate a ticket, answer it and close it.
demoHelpdesk.sampleBadgeHint: This is the service desk of three fictitious brands (Moda Andina, Conecta Sabana and Cooperativa Ceiba). Customers, contacts, orders, amounts and filing numbers are made up. Reference date of the data: Thursday, October 8, 2026.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything runs in your browser with the sample data: filters, search, classification, assignment by skill and workload, macros, SLAs with escalation, PQRS with business days and Colombian public holidays, surveys, metrics and CSV export. Your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.ai: “Draft with AI” really calls an AI model from our server and answers only with the articles of this demo’s knowledge base, citing the source. If the server has no AI key configured, it shows you the most relevant excerpts and tells you so.
howItWorks.simulated: Channels and sending are simulated: no message or survey is actually sent. Classification, confidence and auto-reply use keyword rules, not an AI model.
howItWorks.project: In your project we connect your real channels (for example, WhatsApp Business and your email), load your knowledge base and, if you need it, classify tickets with an AI model trained on your own tickets.

refund.title: How to process a refund or a duplicate charge
refund.body: Check in the payment gateway that there are two approved transactions. If the charge is duplicated, request the reversal from the payments panel: the money returns to the payment method in 3 to 8 business days, depending on the bank. Record the request number in the ticket and let the customer know.
refund.reply: Hi {name}, we confirmed the duplicate charge and have already requested the refund. The money returns to your payment method in 3 to 8 business days, depending on your bank. We’ll email you the receipt.

einvoice.title: I didn’t receive my electronic invoice
einvoice.body: The electronic invoice is emailed to the registered address when it is issued. If it doesn’t arrive, check the spam folder and confirm the registered email is correct. The PDF and XML can be downloaded from “My invoices” at any time. If the email is wrong, update it and resend the invoice.
einvoice.reply: Hi {name}, your electronic invoice is sent to the email address you registered, so please also check your spam folder. You can download the PDF and XML from “My invoices” anytime. If you prefer, we can resend it to another email.

pse.title: Pending or declined PSE payments
pse.body: A PSE payment can stay pending for up to 30 minutes while the bank confirms it. If the bank declines it, no money is debited. If the customer sees the debit and the payment shows as declined, the bank reverses the money automatically in 1 to 3 business days.
pse.reply: Hi {name}, a PSE payment can stay pending for up to 30 minutes while your bank confirms it. If the bank declined it and you see the debit, the reversal is automatic within 1 to 3 business days. If it doesn’t show up, write to us with the receipt.

password.title: Reset your password or access code
password.body: On the sign-in screen choose “Forgot your password?”. A link is sent to the registered email, valid for 15 minutes. If the SMS verification code doesn’t arrive, check the signal and that the registered number is correct; a new code can be requested every 60 seconds.
password.reply: Hi {name}, on the sign-in screen choose “Forgot your password?” and you’ll get a link by email, valid for 15 minutes. If the SMS code doesn’t arrive, you can request a new one every 60 seconds. If it still doesn’t work, reply here and we’ll help you.

orderStatus.title: Order status and tracking number
orderStatus.body: The tracking number is emailed when the order leaves the warehouse and also appears in “My orders”. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days, and to other towns 4 to 7 business days.
orderStatus.reply: Hi {name}, you can check your order status under “My orders” with your tracking number, which is also emailed to you when the order leaves the warehouse. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days. If it doesn’t arrive within that time, reply here and we’ll look into it.

address.title: Change the delivery address
address.body: The address can be changed as long as the order has not left the warehouse. Confirm the full new address (neighborhood, apartment and city) and update it on the order. If it has already shipped, request the change from the carrier, which may charge a fee.
address.reply: Hi {name}, we can change the address as long as your order hasn’t left the warehouse. Send us the full address (neighborhood, apartment and city) and we’ll update it right away.

returns.title: Exchanges and returns
returns.body: For online purchases, customers have a right of withdrawal within 5 business days after delivery (Colombian Consumer Statute, Law 1480 of 2011). Size exchanges are requested in “My orders” within 30 days after delivery, with the item unused and with its tags.
returns.reply: Hi {name}, you can request the exchange in “My orders” within 30 days after delivery, with the item unused and with its tags. If you’d rather return it, you have a right of withdrawal within 5 business days after delivery.

slowInternet.title: Slow or intermittent internet: troubleshooting
slowInternet.body: Before escalating: 1) check whether there is a reported outage in the area; 2) ask the customer to unplug the modem for 30 seconds; 3) test the speed over a cable; 4) check how many devices are connected. If the internet light is still red, escalate to level 2 support.
slowInternet.reply: Hi {name}, let’s check it together: unplug the modem for 30 seconds and plug it back in. If the internet light is still red, let us know and we’ll escalate the case to technical support right away.

visit.title: Schedule or reschedule a technician visit
visit.body: Technician visits are scheduled in a morning slot (8:00 to 12:00) or an afternoon slot (14:00 to 18:00), Monday to Saturday. The technician confirms by WhatsApp one hour before. If the visit doesn’t happen because of the company, it is not charged.
visit.reply: Hi {name}, we can schedule the visit in the morning slot (8:00 to 12:00) or the afternoon slot (14:00 to 18:00), Monday to Saturday. The technician will confirm by WhatsApp one hour before. Which slot works for you?

cancelPlan.title: Cancel or pause a plan
cancelPlan.body: Before cancelling, offer an alternative: switching to a cheaper plan or pausing the service for up to 2 months. If the customer insists, file the cancellation request; it takes effect at the end of the billing cycle.
cancelPlan.reply: Hi {name}, before cancelling, we can move you to a cheaper plan or pause the service for up to 2 months at no cost. If you prefer to cancel, we’ll file your request and it will take effect at the end of your billing cycle.

t1.subject: I was charged twice through PSE
t1.m1: Hi, yesterday I paid for my order #MA-20931 through PSE and my bank statement shows two charges of COP 189,900. Please refund one of them.
t1.m3: Hi Lucía, I’m sorry for the trouble. I’m already checking the two charges on your order #MA-20931 with the payments team.
t1.m4: Thanks. How long will it take to get my money back? This is the third time this has happened and I’m fed up.
t1.n1: Frequent customer. The payment gateway shows two approved transactions 40 seconds apart.

t2.subject: No internet since last night
t2.m1: (Call transcript) I’ve had no internet since last night. I already restarted the modem three times and the internet light is still red. I work from home and this is unacceptable.
t2.m2: Javier, I checked your service: there’s a reported outage in your area. Your case is logged and I’ll let you know as soon as we have an estimated fix time.
t2.n1: Area-wide outage at the Villavicencio Centro node. Network incident open with level 2 support.

t3.subject: I want to cancel my TV plan
t3.m1: Good morning. I want to cancel my TV plan because I hardly use it. What do I need to do?
t3.m3: Hi Marta, we filed your request under number PQRS-2026-0418. Before you cancel, I can move you to the internet-only plan, which lowers your bill without changing your speed. Shall I send you the comparison?

t4.subject: Change the delivery address for order #MA-21055
t4.m1: Hi, I just placed order #MA-21055 and got the address wrong. It’s Carrera 45 # 12-30, apartment 502. Can you change it before it ships?

t5.subject: Thanks for the great service
t5.m1: I just wanted to thank Ana: she helped me exchange a size in minutes. Excellent service!
t5.m2: Thank you, Sofía! We’re so glad. We’re here for whatever you need.

t6.subject: My electronic invoice didn’t arrive
t6.m1: Good morning. This month my electronic invoice for the internet service never reached my email, and I need it for my business accounting.
t6.n1: First-reply SLA breached: priority went from Medium to High and the shift supervisor was notified (simulated notice).

t7.subject: Can’t sign in to their account
t7.m1: Hi, I'm trying to log in to my account to check my order, but it says my password is wrong. I already tried twice. Can you help me, please?

t8.subject: Refund pending for three weeks
t8.m1: I returned a jacket on September 14 and was told the COP 249,900 refund would arrive within 5 business days. It’s been three weeks and nobody answers me. If I don’t get a solution today, I’ll file a complaint with the SIC.

t9.subject: Where is my order #MA-20877?
t9.m1: Hi, can you tell me where my order #MA-20877 is? I bought it on Monday and I still don’t have the shipping tracking number.
t9.m2: Hi Valentina, you can check your order status under “My orders” with your tracking number, which is also emailed to you when the order leaves the warehouse. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days. If it doesn’t arrive within that time, reply here and we’ll look into it.

t10.subject: Claim for a charged technician visit that never happened
t10.m1: I was charged COP 80,000 for a technician visit that never happened: nobody came on September 18. I’m asking you to credit that amount on my next invoice.
t10.m2: Hi Hernán, we filed your claim under number PQRS-2026-0402. We’re checking the visit order with the technical team and will reply within the legal term.
t10.m3: Any news? It’s been more than ten days.
t10.n1: The technician reported “customer not home”, but there’s no photo or signature of the visit. I suggest crediting the COP 80,000 on the October bill.

t11.subject: Not getting the code to sign in to the app
t11.m1: Hi, I’m trying to get into the cooperative’s app and the SMS verification code never arrives. I already checked that my number is correct.

t12.subject: Request for a certificate of contributions and loan status
t12.m1: Good afternoon. I need a certificate of my contributions and my loan status to present at the bank. How do I request it?
t12.m2: Hi Andrés, we filed your petition under number PQRS-2026-0410. The collections department issues the certificate and we’ll send it to your registered email.

surveys.s1: Ana solved my size exchange in minutes.
surveys.s5: The technician arrived two hours late.
surveys.s9: They refunded the duplicate charge the same day.

pse.label: Double PSE charge
pse.text: Hi, I paid for my purchase through PSE and COP 159,900 was taken from my account twice. Can you refund the duplicate charge? I’m really annoyed.

outage.label: Internet down (call)
outage.text: (Call transcript) I’ve had no internet since this morning and the wifi signal doesn’t show up. I already restarted the router. I need the service to work and this is unacceptable.

tracking.label: Where is my order?
tracking.text: Hi, where is my order #MA-21102? It’s been three days and I want to know the shipping tracking number.

password.label: Password reset
password.text: Hello, I forgot my password and I can't log in to my account. Can you help me, please?

sic.label: Complaint mentioning the SIC
sic.text: Good afternoon. For a month I’ve been asking you to fix a COP 95,000 charge on my invoice and nobody gives me a solution. If you don’t fix it this week, I’ll file a complaint with the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC).

cancel.label: Subscription cancellation
cancel.text: Hi, I want to cancel my TV subscription starting next month. How do I do it?
